title: Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/docs-align-scan.ts to stop the shape_existence invariant reporting vessel RO
description:
Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/docs-align-scan.ts to stop the shape_existence invariant reporting vessel ROLE names as unknown shape tokens.

The defect: shapeMarkerRx is /shape|type:|output_shapes|input_shapes/ and it matches the bare word "shape" anywhere on a line. docs/SUBSTRATE.md line 17 describes how each unit maps to a role and ends "...compose those into deployable shapes:", so the marker fires and every backticked token on that line is then tested as a shape token. The result is 14 false findings on correct documentation: store, control, api, compute, models, ui, transport, seed, infra, autonomy, registry, desktop, plus the role-group alias full.

The fix: inside the token loop, skip a token when the same line also refers to roles. Add a role-context regex such as /\\brole\\b|\\broles\\b|ENABLED_ROLES|role-group/i and, when that matches the line, do not emit a shape_existence finding for tokens on it. Keep every other behaviour identical.

A validator that fails on correct documentation trains its readers to ignore it, which is worse than having no validator.
